exposure: Maternal metformin (10 mg/kg) initiated in early pregnancy
outcome: Fetal metformin bioaccumulation (kidney, liver, gut, amniotic fluid, placenta, serum, urine)
cohort: 11 Rhesus macaque fetuses from dams initiated on metformin or vehicle control within 30 days of conception.
finding: Maternal metformin initiated in early pregnancy resulted in significant fetal bioaccumulation, leading to fetal growth restriction (lower delivery weight, less skeletal muscle, decreased organ fat) and renal dysmorphology in Rhesus macaques.
